sql:
SELECT
  ps.skill,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps.posting_key) AS mention_count
FROM posting_skills AS ps
JOIN fct_posting AS fp
  ON ps.posting_key = fp.posting_key
WHERE
  fp.is_open IS TRUE AND fp.remote_us IS TRUE AND fp.is_canonical_listing IS TRUE
GROUP BY
  ps.skill
ORDER BY
  mention_count DESC
LIMIT 10
